fields.name: visits_done
fields.description: Number of completed 'move to the top of the target' subgoals so far in the episode, counting each arrival of the held cube over a target (right or left). It is 0 at the first step and stays 0 through the step that ends the pick-up. It increases by exactly 1 at each decision step that ends a B subgoal, i.e. every step whose final scene shows the cube held in the gripper AND a highlighted target in the scene. Whether the earlier execution frames of that step already showed the highlight does not matter: a step whose first execution frame already carries the highlight (a quick arrival) still counts as exactly one arrival. It does not change at the step that ends the put-down (cube no longer held) or at the press-button step. e.g. 3
